overview_description.description: Souffle Club operates a professional networking platform that reconstructs professional profiles around credible, context-based recommendations rather than traditional resumes. The service enables users to answer detailed, behavior-focused prompts that nominate peers for specific skills and collaborative scenarios. These responses build a structured trust graph that captures who trusts whom and in what context, emphasizing real-world working relationships. The platform focuses on professional discovery, expert identification, and reputation signaling for roles such as engineers, designers, founders, and investors. Souffle Club also experiments with community features and discussion formats where high-quality contributions can reveal contributor identities for recognition. The product targets professionals seeking more nuanced career discovery, hiring, and collaboration signals than conventional social networking sites provide.
